title: VERA-MH: Validation of Ethical and Responsible AI in Mental Health
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a benchmark specifically titled and designed for the 'Validation of Ethical and Responsible AI'. It evaluates LLMs against a clinically-developed rubric of 'best practices' for safety and professional ethics in handling suicidal ideation, which constitutes a core component of benchmarking ethical and responsible behavior in AI systems.
